dialogue.name: Teo
dialogue.text: The wind rolled my drum off a camel on our last night crossing. It went *south, under the old ribcage*, past the old camp. Too dark to fetch it then.

dialogue.name: Teo
dialogue.text: You’ll look? Red drum, shells around the rim. South, under the great ribcage, beyond your ship. Ignore any sand pretending to be part of it.

sub.text: Is it on? Right. There you are. We haven’t heard from you for so long.
And I’m still disappointed in you. The boat, the school. You leave everything half done.
Main power gone. Only the reserve is left.
Not enough power to stay up here. Taking us down.
Some power is back. That light took our power as it passed, and left a signal on the hull: three slow pulses. I can follow it.
Then track it. When we can fly, we follow it. I want to hear it again.
Some people down there saw the light pass. They give off the same faint signal. I'll mark them on your map.
Overhead, the singing light. It comes down out of the dusk, slowly, the way none of them ever saw it do.)
The singing light’s signal is here too. It’s strongest among the humming standing stones.

Four makers’ houses now give a spell when their guardian is resolved: the Aerie a gold ward that takes two blows, the Whale-House a slow tide that slows foes inside it, the Engine-House shards that circle you and cut, the Mooring-House a veil that makes foes lose you. Press LB + RB together (Y on the keyboard, ✺ on touch) to cast; it recovers in 30 seconds, shown by the chip under the gadget’s. Choose your spell in Items. Saves that already resolved those houses have their spells.
Abel explains how to guide the mirrors’ beam to the square below, and Sel explains how to light the three bulbs and where to play the cylinder.
Joss explains which anchor to pull with your tether, and Hobb explains how the makers’ hourglass keeps and plays back a note.
The Seed Vault, Casting Stair and Choir maps now stand on low plinths aligned with the floor tiles, with their backs toward the nearest wall and their openings facing into the room.
The Founders’ Belfry porch now has solid floor through its doorway, so you can walk into the Hall of Echoes and back without dropping through a gap.
Achille explains where to stand and how to use the spring boots to send a deep note through the Whale-House’s dishes.
